title: Mattock wind-up and the floor
description: With his back to the yeti king, the player swings a mattock. The swing makes its wind-up behind him twice, and the two take 12 of the yeti king's 30 hit points in four steps. The hit in front breaks the block he stands on, and he drops into the hole.
